levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Finds the wrong date or event.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Finds today's date and a real event correctly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Finds the date and event correctly and self-checks the day-count by recounting.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Count is off by more than one day.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Count is exact or off by one.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Count is exact and the learner explains their counting method.

lookFors: Event chosen is genuinely within the next two weeks.
Day-count is verifiable by recounting on the calendar.
Reflection compares the guess to the actual count specifically.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
